The two most recent changes, applied simultaneously ~2 minutes before onset, altered the pod's DNS resolution behaviour: the cluster-default DNS policy was removed and replaced by an explicit custom DNS configuration pointing at a single public resolver. The workload itself was created only ~3 minutes before onset, alongside creation of the frontend Service object — this is a fresh bring-up, not a mutation of a long-running stable deployment. A DNS configuration that bypasses the in-cluster resolver would prevent resolution of cluster-internal service names, making this the strongest candidate cause among the four changes.
